propositions: code_health metric is Python-only and coupled to rebar project structure; needs polyglot analyzer stack (scc/lizard/jscpd) to support non-Python client projects

rebar core hardcodes Python-specific paths (src/rebar/**/*.py, .github/module-size-limit.txt) in metrics and fabricates zeros or leaks exceptions for unavailable data instead of honest Unavailable signal
analyzer + tool dependencies (scc, lizard, jscpd) must ship behind optional [metrics] extra to keep rebar core dependency-free
analyzer interface must accept per-project language config, emit genuine Unavailable when no analyzer configured, and never silently scan hardcoded paths or fabricate authoritative-labeled metrics
module-size cap must become optional per-project policy over generic LOC signal, decoupled from rebar governance artifacts
